Cancer and Cancer compatibility

How two Cancer signs are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Water (both)
Modes
Cardinal (chara), both
Ruling planets
Moon
Place in the zodiac
Same sign (1/1)
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
5 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
7 of 7 points
Sign-level view
Strongly supportive

Cancer horoscope

The elements: both Water

Two Cancer signs share the Water element, so they tend to understand each other's pace and priorities without explanation. The tradition's caution is that a pair of the same sign also shares the same blind spots, with nobody to balance them.

Temperament

Two Cancer signs are cardinal (chara) signs, the starters of the zodiac. Both like to take the lead, which brings energy and also the question of who decides. Taking turns to lead is the traditional advice.

The ruling planets

Both partners are ruled by the Moon. One ruling planet is the strongest form of Graha Maitri, the full 5 points: the two signs want things for the same deep reasons, even when they show it differently.

Their place in the zodiac

Both partners have the same sign, which in Bhakoot is a 1/1 placement and scores the full 7 points. In Guna Milan the same Moon sign is usually checked against the nakshatras as well, because two people of one sign can still be born under different stars.

What each brings

Cancer is traditionally said to bring care, emotional depth and a gift for making a home to a relationship, and to need reassurance, emotional safety and closeness to family. Two Cancer understand each other's moods without a word and put home and family first. It is one of the most nurturing pairings there is. Both are sensitive, though, and both tend to withdraw when hurt, so a small slight can turn into two people waiting for the other to come out of their shell first.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Cancer and Cancer compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: strongly supportive. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 5 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 7 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Is it good to marry someone of the same sign?

The tradition treats it as easy at the sign level, with the full Bhakoot and Graha Maitri points, and then looks at the nakshatras, because a few nakshatra pairs within one sign raise their own questions in Guna Milan.
